title: Query-log delivery refuses a store row whose fetch host the public root names only inside a url
goal: redact.known() counts the host of every http or https url in the public root's text files as a known host, so a fetch host a source url or census row names (cas.docs.cisecurity.org) passes ql_store.public_host and the store gates, while a host the public root never names is still redacted to the host placeholder

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_store,redact;ok=ql_store.public_host('cas.docs.cisecurity.org');neg=redact.redact('ci7.qzvx-internal.net')=='ci7.qzvx-internal.net';print('source host public:',ok,'| unnamed host kept:',neg);sys.exit(0 if ok and not neg else 1)

gates.question: How does redact.known() count url hosts: a separate URL_HOST regex over http/https urls, or a loosened HOST lookbehind that allows a host after //? HOST also drives redaction of text, so loosening it would change what redact.redact flags in every url; URL_HOST only widens the allowlist.

notes: Found 2026-10-23 from the kbmon alert 'query-log delivery REFUSED': apply --push refused since 15:41Z on 2026-10/20261023T120151Z-e3887743.jsonl:17 'fetch host is not a public host' for cas.docs.cisecurity.org. redact.HOST's lookbehind skips a host after //, so known() holds only bare mentions; 66a1f2967 (ST-6wsgvy3z) rewrote kb/public/_census/2026-10-21.csv and dropped the last bare mention. Operator 2026-10-23: count url hosts (P1, this sprint). The leak guard stays: a host the public root never names is still redacted, which the repro's second half plants.
